adminSettlements.title: Settlements
adminSettlements.subtitle: How shops get paid — the shape of it, before it exists.
adminSettlements.unavailableTitle: Payouts are not part of this build
adminSettlements.unavailableBody: This demo runs entirely on one machine with no payment provider and no bank connection, so there is nothing here that could move money. Rather than show invented figures, the screen shows the structure a real settlement run would have — which is the part worth agreeing on now.
adminSettlements.emptyBody: Rows would appear here once a period closes: one per shop, with the revenue it fulfilled, the mall’s commission at the agreed rate, and what is left to pay out.
adminSettlements.todayBody: Every order in this build is cash on delivery or HesabPay direct to the shop, so the shop already holds the money and the mall is not in the payment path at all. Commission would be invoiced separately. If Gulbahar wants to collect payments centrally instead, that is a different flow — and a bigger conversation than a settlement table.
